frame: origin = field centre on the tile top surface; +x toward the BLUE alliance wall (right, seen from the audience); +y away from the audience; +z up; headings from +x counter-clockwise
notes: Field size: am-0481 perimeter is 141 in inside / 143 in outside; FTC Docs measured 3580 mm between inside faces. Manual figures scaled by their own 97 in and 54 in dimensions give 141.4 in inside and a 23.5 in tile pitch; the EFSG top view reproduces HIVE centre-to-centre 25.5 and frame width 49.46 only with a 23.5 in pitch. 144/24 are nominal (manual 9.1: +/-1 in general tolerance). Tile seams at 0, +/-23.5, +/-47; edge tiles trimmed.
Wall: 12.125 in from floor (am-0481) minus 0.59 in tile = 11.5; FTC Docs 313 mm total minus 13 mm tile = 11.8; 11.6 used (+/-0.2).
HIVE x: red HIVE on the red (-x) side in every top view; +/-12.75 from the 25.5 centre-to-centre; EFSG top view measures -12.73 / +12.78.

upSide at match start: red up-CELL on the audience side (sigma -1), blue up-CELL on the far side (sigma +1); agrees with the NECTAR staged in the up-CELLs and with the down-CELL of each HIVE facing the flower on its own side (-23.5,+y wall for red; +23.5,-y wall for blue).

CELL set is self-consistent: aOut = 18.84/2 + 12.04 = 21.46 (overall 42.92 vs published 42.91); b0 = (53.5 - 43.95 - 21.46*sin30)/cos30 = -1.3625 gives lip z 53.50. topZ 65.62 = lip + 14*cos30, which confirms tilt and 14 in height but not b0 on its own. Fig 9-9 scaled pivot-to-floor gives b0 = -1.45 (+/-0.1). Fig 9-10 side-view CELL corners match the model within 0.7 in.

The 20 x 14 x 7.61 pentagon is the inner opening; the ring adds ~0.4-0.5 in outside it (outer width 20.8 in top view) and a lug extends 1.6 in below the base at w = 0. Inner corners have ~0.5 in fillets (ignored).
Lowest down-CELL point is ~30.7 in (lug) / 31.6 in (ring corner); the 25.5 in label in Fig 9-10 does not match its own drawing scale. 25.5 kept only as the swing-clearance warning threshold.

Arm bar: 1 in square tube centred at b = -2.2 from a = +/-4.4 to +/-21.46 (through the ring lugs), V plates rising to a flat hub |a| <= 1.5 around the pivot. Radius 0.8 covers plates and lugs (b down to -3.0) and its top (-1.4) stays below b0.

Frame: each triangle leans inward in x (0.271 in per in of height) and its legs converge in y (0.446); leg centrelines meet at z ~42.45 at x = +/-12.4 (~0.35 in inboard of the pivot, within +/-0.5 in); leg base centres (+/-23.9, +/-18.95, 0). Legs ~1 in square tube (radius 0.6). Foot bars centred x = +/-24.0, outer faces at +/-24.73 = 49.46/2. Crossbar joins the top corners at z ~41.8; corner blocks hold the pivot cradles up to ~44.6. Measured from Fig 9-10 front and side views and the EFSG top view; +/-0.5 in.
Logo panels sit on the outer faces of the leaning legs, z 34.3-40.0, |x| <= 13.9; may be absent at events (manual 9.6.1), so treat as optional obstacles.

FLOWERs sit at perimeter panel joints, on seam lines +/-23.5 along their wall; opening axis ~2.3 +/- 0.3 in from the wall inner face. Top ring ~5.9 in along the wall x ~4.8 in deep; backstop 1.25 in above the 21.5 in opening.
LOADING ZONE: 11 +/- 0.125 in deep from the wall; long tape edges run on the inner edge of the tile-seam tabs (~0.4 in inside seams 23.5 and 47), giving ~22.7 in. Red on tile A5, blue on F2.
GARDEN: 2 in tape on tile A1 (red) / F6 (blue), from the side wall to the inner tab edge of the next seam (~23.1 in); its wall-side edge sits ~0.5 in off the wall on the trimmed tile tabs.
ALLIANCE AREA: tape inner edges on the outside of seams 1 and 5, outer width ~97 in (y +/-48.5); 54 +/- 1 in deep from the perimeter outer face (x = +/-71.5).
